features.name: Wind Domain Spells
features.description:
| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | feather fall, thunderwave |
| 3rd | gust of wind, misty step |
| 5th | fly, wind wall |
| 7th | conjure minor elementals (air only), freedom of movement |
| 9th | cloudkill, conjure elemental (air only) |

features.name: Wind's Chosen
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you learn the *mage hand* cantrip and gain proficiency in Nature. When you cast *mage hand*, you can make the hand invisible and control it as a bonus action.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Grasp Not the Wind
features.description: At 2nd level, use Channel Divinity to end the grappled condition on yourself and gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn. You don't provoke opportunity attacks while flying this way.

features.name: Stormshield
features.description:
At 6th level, when you take lightning or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to both lightning and thunder damage (including the triggering attack) until the start of your next turn.

Uses equal to WIS modifier (min 1); regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Stormshield
payload.description: When you take lightning or thunder damage, gain resistance to both types until start of your next turn.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Dire Tempest
features.description:
At 17th level, as an action, create a 20-ft-radius tornado at a point within 120 ft lasting until start of your next turn. Huge or smaller creatures within the area: STR save or take 8d6 bludgeoning and are thrown 1d4 × 10 ft into the air (half damage, not thrown on success). Falling creatures take falling damage and land prone.

Creatures within 15 ft that start their turn there: STR save or dragged into the tornado (thrown 1d4 × 10 ft, falling damage, prone). 1/long rest.

payload.name: Dire Tempest
payload.description: Create 20-ft tornado within 120 ft for 1 round. Huge or smaller: STR save or 8d6 bludgeoning and thrown 1d4×10 ft (prone). Creatures within 15 ft dragged in on failed save.
